subject: The secret setting 95% of SoulPlan users never touch
preview_text: This one tiny tweak is what separates couples who plan okay dates from those who plan unforgettable ones. Most skip it.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. For months, I thought the AI date generator was good. Then I discovered a single setting buried in the app that made it feel like I'd been using a toy version. The difference in the date ideas was honestly embarrassing—I'd been leaving the best stuff on the table.

It turns out the magic isn't just in telling the AI your interests. It's in telling it what you DON'T want. The pros use the 'Exclude' filter in the AI settings. They quietly block overdone, boring, or just 'not us' activities before a single idea is generated. This forces the AI to get creative and dig deeper, past the obvious dinner-and-a-movie suggestions. The result? Dates that feel like they were crafted just for your unique dynamic, every single time.

This is the hack: In SoulPlan, go to 'AI Date Generator,' tap the settings icon, and find the 'Exclude Activities' field. Type in three things you're absolutely tired of. It could be 'expensive tasting menus,' 'crowded bars,' or even 'long drives.' Hit save. Watch as your next batch of ideas instantly levels up. It's the difference between a date and an experience.

Open the app right now and set your three exclusions. It takes 60 seconds, and your next date will thank you. P.S. The couples who do this are the ones whose 'Date History' tab looks like a scrapbook of inside jokes and core memories. Don't let your tab fill up with 'meh.'
